name: Flooded Forest
desc: A forest that drowned standing up — bare dead trunks in four hazed planes rise out of water so still it works as a mirror, their reflection sliding and breaking in slow displaced bands while mist scrolls between the ranks and rings open where something moves below; bleached cold timber, a tannin-black cypress swamp at dusk, moonlit silver, a contour wireframe, or a hard Rorschach silhouette.

energy.doc: how alive the surface is — glint brightness, ripple throw and overall contrast

scale.doc: how tall the drowned timber stands (rebuilds the trunk field and its mirror)

density.doc: how many trunks per plane, and how many glints work the surface

ripple.doc: how badly the water breaks the reflection — 0 is a perfect mirror, 1 shatters it

mist.doc: aerial perspective — how far the back ranks dissolve

hue.doc: palette hue shift off the default cold teal

x.doc: which side the light rakes the bark from

y.doc: the waterline — the mirror. Low y gives more water and more reflection

style.doc: aesthetic: drowned = bleached cold timber in still water, large-format, eerie; cypress = tannin-black swamp at dusk, warm, ragged crowns; nocturne = moonlit silver on black water, dark key; wire = no mass at all, trunks as contour wireframe over a survey grid; blot = the mirror makes it a Rorschach — pure silhouette, no interior modelling

act.doc: multi-minute programme — dead calm, a breath moving through, or the mist closing over

seed.doc: regenerates the trunk field, its lean, bark and broken stubs

alpha.doc: how far the world sits back behind the performers
